lines.text: Mira's thumb hovered over send. Then she noticed the message hidden above her draft.
Mira and Asha are fictional. She had written an Atomy recommendation for her oldest friend.
Above it, Asha had asked: Can we talk? Rough day. Mira had never answered.
She deleted the pitch. I’m here. Do you still want to talk? This time, she sent it.
Asha replied: Yes, please. Mira put away the shopping list and pressed call.
